scope: Only the frozen14 controller/HTTP-adapter cases; all source/current/Node/helper pins unchanged. No producer, renderer, backend rerun, browser, native, network or full validation.

testImpact.basis: Explicit regression/boundary selection plus original observed module/load graph; no per-function instrumentation or wider integration claim.

cases: question load and local choice write nothing; only explicit confirmation sends the five fields
unchanged and invalid choices cannot confirm for options, slider or equipment
uncertain retries retain the identical command even when a status read still returns the question
reload preserves a committed saved receipt when evaluation is unavailable
missing evaluation and invented waiting or no-match envelopes fail closed
ready requires a distinct offer and the current quote brief; malformed requirement rows fail closed
stale version requires a refresh; forbidden and earlier-run responses do not retain account data
authentication loss clears a saved receipt while non-auth source failure preserves it
duplicate confirmation is suppressed and teardown ignores late server replies
snapshots and observers cannot mutate the server question or retained command
malformed questions and malformed success receipts cannot produce a confirmed save
HTTP adapter sends strict selectors and confirmation with session cookies and no-store
HTTP adapter rejects extra authority and incomplete bodies without fetching
HTTP abort, malformed JSON and unsuccessful HTTP success envelopes remain unavailable

testImpact.fixtures: Inline values/functions in the exact pinned controller test; no external fixture, database or producer import. Four package metadata inputs remain pinned.
testImpact.subprocessEdges: Gated Python direct child execs exact Node test coordinator; one observed Node test child, identities retained in original ownership manifest.
testImpact.timing: 2.485448625 seconds includes supervisor/OS/cleanup overhead; original TAP retains each test duration.
